title: spHawkes: Semi-Parametric Self-Exciting Point Process Models — spHawkes-package
text: Fits semi-parametric spatio-temporal Hawkes (self-exciting) point process models event data via stochastic-declustering EM algorithm (Zhuang & Mateu, 2019), sf point layer study-region polygon. conditional intensity sum background term, capturing baseline place-based risk, triggering term, capturing extra risk past event induces nearby space soon time: $$\lambda(x, y, t \mid H_t) =   \mu_0 \, \mu_T(t) \, \mu_m(t) \, \mu_w(t) \, \mu_b(x, y)   + \int_{-\infty}^{t} \int_{W} g(t - s) \, h(x - u, y - v) \,   N(du \, dv \, ds),$$ \(W\) study region \(N\) counting measure events, triggering term adds \(\, g(t - t_i) \, h(x - x_i, y - y_i)\) events \(\) \(t\). background factors (long-term trend, calendar month, day week, spatial surface) triggering kernels estimated non-parametrically; \(\mu_0\) branching ratio \(\) updated closed form.
